steps.name: seed-item
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([{ id:'rot-test', defId:'sofa-3seat', position:[10.5,4.1], rotation:0, props:{} }]); s.selectItem('rot-test'); })()

steps.name: open-view-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')].find(x=>/^\s*View/.test(x.textContent||'')); if(!b) throw new Error('View menu button not found'); if(b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') b.click(); })()

steps.name: show-furniture
steps.eval: (() => { const fb=document.querySelector("button[title^='Show furniture footprints']"); if(!fb) throw new Error('Furniture toggle not found'); if(fb.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true') fb.click(); })()

steps.name: rotate-pointerdown
steps.eval: (() => { const knob=document.querySelector("[data-rot-handle='rot-test']"); const kb=knob.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__kx=kb.left+kb.width/2; window.__ky=kb.top+kb.height/2; const opt=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,pointerId:7,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:x,clientY:y}); knob.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',opt(window.__kx,window.__ky))); })()

steps.name: rotate-pointermove
steps.eval: (() => { /* MUST be the plan CANVAS svg — '.plan-screen svg' matches a header ICON svg first (the header, compass and scale bar all render svgs before the canvas), so the move never reaches the canvas onPointerMove (UIUX-19b). */ const svg=document.querySelector('.plan-canvas svg'); const opt=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,pointerId:7,pointerType:'mouse',isPrimary:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:x,clientY:y}); /* Knob starts due-south of the item centre; sweep it up-and-left a quarter-turn so the pointer angle changes well past one 15-deg step. */ svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',opt(window.__kx-160,window.__ky-160))); })()

steps.name: assert-snapped
steps.eval: (() => { const r=window.__store.getState().items.find(i=>i.id==='rot-test').rotation; const step=Math.PI/12; const rem=Math.abs(((r%step)+step)%step); if (rem>1e-6 && Math.abs(rem-step)>1e-6) throw new Error('rotation not 15-deg snapped: '+r); return r; })()
